description_md: Cruise natural key (YYYY-MM-NODC); FK to `cruise`. Derived via `derive_cruise_key_on_casts()` from the resolved short cruise code + ship code.
NODC ship key; FK to `ship`. Resolved from the short cruise code's trailing ship code via `derive_cruise_key_on_casts()`.
Point geometry (WGS84) from longitude/latitude via `add_point_geom()`. NULL for schema variants with no position field (e.g. `mets_schema_raw_2012` -- see questions.csv mets_16).
CalCOFI grid cell; FK to `grid`. Derived via `assign_grid_key()`; NULL wherever `geom` is NULL.
Measurement type; FK to `measurement_type` (shared registry across bottle/ctd/dic/mets).
Numeric value of the measurement; units carried by `measurement_type`, not here.
